profile.headline: Software Developer at Compassion International
profile.summary:
Innovative Front-End Developer with a strong interest in UX Design with expertise in Next.js and React,
committed to delivering delightful user experiences.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
www.compassioncauses.com

• Proficient in React, Next.js, HTML, CSS, Typescript and JavaScript to create seamless user interfaces for sponsor-child connections.
• Utilize API integration for smooth interaction between front-end and back-end systems.
• Responsible for creating various features and UX designs on Figma.
• Organize development tasks using Jira and GitHub projects for improved team coordination.

positions.title: Software Engineering Immersive Program
positions.description: Completed 3-month, 500-hour full-time and full-stack web development program providing experience with front- and back-end programming languages, tools, and methodologies including: HTML, CSS, SASS, Javascript, MongoDB, NodeJS, ReactJS, Git, Github, wire framing, user stories/requirements planning, and test driven development.

positions.title: Piano Teacher
positions.description: Passionate about creating engaging and tailored lessons that foster technical skill, creativity, and musical expression, committed to helping students achieve their musical goals while fostering a deep appreciation for the art of piano playing
positions.insights: Piano Performance, Music Education and +4 skills

positions.title: Marketing Intern (DC’s 107.3 Radio)
positions.description: Created graphic design contents for social media platforms and website, Illustrated a published full-page graphic design for DC Modern Luxury’s Magazine (August 2015), Collaborated with Marketing team with developing new ideas to increase social media and website traffic, Assisted in setting up and moderating promotional events, Wrote daily blog posts on WordPress, Assisted with running the Sarah, Ty, Mel Morning Show

volunteerExperiences.description: Traveled to Haiti to help refurbish a church effected by the 2010 Haiti earthquake
